title: Most Servicing Calls Are the Same Five Questions: Answering Them With an AI Agent Without Turning an Answer Into a Reg X Notice or a UDAAP Problem
summary: The bulk of a servicing call center's volume is a handful of repeatable questions: my payment, my escrow, my payoff, my statement, my options. They are automatable, and each one has a trapdoor, because a casual answer can misstate what a borrower owes or walk past a sentence that was legally a notice of error. How we let an AI agent handle the repeatable volume while recognizing the moment a question becomes an obligation with a clock.
